Sporting Lisbon vs Manchester United; UEFA Champions League Round 1
Sporting Lisbon vs Manchester United. UEFA Champions League Round 1.
Estádio José Alvalade.
Sporting Lisbon 2
- L Suárez (33rd minute pen, 80th minute)
Manchester United 2
- B Borges Fernandes (48th minute pen, 50th minute)
- Y Tielemans (sent off 93rd minute)
Sporting 2-2 Man Utd: Mauricio Pochettino denied first win by Senne Lammens howler in Champions League
Report as Man Utd self-destruct in bizarre Champions League draw at Sporting; Bruno Fernandes scored twice, including freak goal that bounced off a divot in the ground; Sporting striker Luis Suarez also scored two, benefitting from Senne Lammens' second-half howler
Wednesday 25 November 2026 22:15, UK
Mauricio Pochettino was denied a first victory as Manchester United head coach by a goalkeeping howler from Senne Lammens in an incident-packed 2-2 draw with Sporting in the Champions League as Youri Tielemans was sent off late on.
United looked to be on course for a first away win of the season after captain Bruno Fernandes scored two goals in the first five minutes of the second half only for Lammens to spill the ball in the box for Luis Suarez to equalise with his second goal of the game.
Fernandes thought he had produced a third goal for United to go back in front for a second time shortly after Lammens' error when Sporting goalkeeper Kaique punched into his own net only for it to be ruled out for a foul by Patrick Dorgu following VAR intervention.

Pochettino will feel hard done by not to have won but had to rely on a big slice of luck for Fernandes' second goal which came thanks to the ball rebounding off a divot in the ground two minutes after he had equalised with the game's third penalty.
It was a damaging night for Lammens, who gave away the penalty for Suarez's first goal just 75 seconds after saving the Sporting striker's poorly taken first spot-kick. This is just the latest game when the goalkeeper brought into replace Andre Onana resembled his predecessor.
Key moments from Lisbon...
29: PENALTY TO SPORTING! Martinez fouls Catamo to give Sporting a spot-kick.
31: LAMMENS SAVES IT! Man Utd are spared as Suarez's poor effort is saved by the Belgian.
32: ANOTHER PENALTY TO SPORTING! Seventy-five seconds later, Lammens fouls Araujo in the box to go from hero to zero.
33: GOAL FOR SPORTING! Suarez makes no mistake from his second penalty.
40: NO GOAL! Amad thinks he's levelled for Man Utd but the referee had blown for a foul by Tielemans, who is shown a yellow card.
47: PENALTY TO MAN UTD! Martinez is brought down by Quaresma in the box to give his side a lifeline.
48: GOAL FOR MAN UTD! Fernandes brings his side level from the spot.
50: ANOTHER MAN UTD GOAL! Fernandes scores a freak goal as his soft shot bounces off a divot in the ground and into the back of the net.
80: GOAL FOR SPORTING! A howler from Lammens sees him spill the ball for Suarez to tap in an equaliser
82: GOAL FOR MAN UTD! Sporting goalkeeper Kaique punches the ball into his own net at a corner.
84: GOAL DISALLOWED! Referee rules that Dorgu fouled the goalkeeper after VAR sent him to his monitor.

מנצ'סטר יונייטד סיימה בתיקו שתיים דרמטי מול ספורטינג ליסבון במסגרת ליגת האלופות, במשחק רווי אירועים. ברונו פרננדס הבקיע צמד מהיר בתחילת המחצית השנייה, כולל שער מקרי שנתז מהדשא, והעניק ליונייטד יתרון.

למרות זאת, טעות קשה של השוער סנה לאמנס איפשרה ללואיס סוארס לכבוש את שער השוויון בדקות הוסיום עבור ספורטינג. יורי טילמנס הרחיק בדקות הסיום, ומאוריציו פוצ'טינו נותר ללא ניצחון בכורה בתפקידו כמאמן הקבוצה האנגלית.
